58:17: God Almighty says: “The wealth of these hypocrites will not avail them on the Day of Resurrection, so that they could ransom themselves with it from the humiliating punishment of God, nor will their children, so that they could aid them and rescue them from God when He punishes them. “Those are the companions of the Fire.” He says: These are the ones who supported a people with whom God was angry, and they are the hypocrites, the companions of the Fire, meaning its people who will abide in it forever. He says: They will remain in the Fire forever.
58:18: God Almighty says: These people whom He mentioned are the people of Hell, on the day God will resurrect them all. On the day of the resurrection of the people of Hell, and what He meant by His statement on the day God will resurrect them all is that they will be from their graves alive in the form they were in before their death, and they will swear to Him as they swear to you, lying and falsely. Ibn Abd al-A’la told us: Ibn Thawr told us, on the authority of Muammar, on the authority of Qatada, regarding his statement, And they swear to him, he said: The hypocrite will swear to him on the Day of Resurrection just as he swore to his friends in this world. Bishr told us, he said: Yazid told us, he said: Saeed told us, on the authority of Qatada, regarding His statement, The Day God will resurrect them all, the verse, and God will make the hypocrites swear by their Lord on the Day of Resurrection, just as they swore by His friends in this world. Ibn Humayd narrated: Mihran narrated to us, on the authority of Sufyan, on the authority of Samak ibn Harb al-Bakri, on the authority of Sa`id ibn Jubayr, who said: “The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, was in the shade of a room, and the shade was shrinking around him. He said: ‘A man will come to you, or a man will appear with the eye of a devil, so do not speak to him.’ He did not wait long before he came and looked and saw a blue-eyed man. He said to him: ‘Why do you curse me, you, so-and-so, and so-and-so?’ He went and called his companions, and they swore that they had not done so. Then the verse was revealed: ‘The Day when God will resurrect them all together, they will swear to Him as they swear to you, and they think that they are upon something. Unquestionably, it is they who are the liars.’” His statement: And they think that they are on something means: They think that they are lying about some of the truth in their oaths and swearing by God. Unquestionably, they are the liars in what they swear to.
58:19: God Almighty means by His statement: Satan has overcome them Satan has overcome them “and made them forget the remembrance of God. Those are the party of Satan” meaning his soldiers and followers. Unquestionably, the party of Satan are the losers He says: Unquestionably, the soldiers of Satan and his followers are the ones who are doomed and deceived in their deal.
58:20: God Almighty says: Indeed, those who disobey God and His Messenger in His limits and in what He has imposed upon them of His obligations and are hostile to Him. And the people of interpretation said something similar to what we said about that. Who said that? Bishr told us, he said: Yazid told us, he said: Saeed told us, on the authority of Qatada: Indeed, those who oppose God and His Messenger means: they are hostile to God and His Messenger. Ibn Abd al-A’la told us: Ibn Thawr told us, on the authority of Muammar, on the authority of Qatada, in a similar manner. Muhammad bin Amr told us, he said: Abu Asim told us, he said: Isa told us, and Al-Harith told me, he said: Al-Hasan told us, he said: Zarqa’ told us, all of them, on the authority of Ibn Abi Nujayh, on the authority of Mujahid, regarding his statement, They oppose God and His Messenger, he said: They are hostile, they are hostile. And His statement: Those are among the humiliated, God Almighty says: These are the ones who oppose God and His Messenger among the humiliated, because victory belongs to God and His Messenger.
58:21: And His statement: God has decreed, ‘I and My messengers will surely prevail.’ He says: God has decreed and written in the Mother of the Book, ‘I and My messengers will surely prevail over whoever opposes Me and is hostile to Me.’ And the people of interpretation said something similar to what we said about that. Who said that? Bishr told us, he said: Yazid told us, he said: Saeed told us, on the authority of Qatada, regarding his statement, God has decreed, ‘I will surely prevail, I and My messengers’… the verse, he said: God wrote a book and implemented it. His saying: Indeed, God is Powerful and Exalted in Might means: God, may His praise be glorified, has power and ability to destroy anyone who opposes Him and His Messenger. He has power, so no one can take revenge on Him if He destroys his friend, punishes him, or harms him in his soul.
58:22: God, the Most High, means by His saying: You will not find a people who believe in God and the Last Day having affection for those who oppose God and His Messenger You will not find, O Muhammad, a people who believe in God and acknowledge the Last Day having affection for those who oppose God and His Messenger, who oppose them, and who disobey God’s commands and prohibitions. Even if they were their fathers He says: Even if those who opposed God and His Messenger were their fathers or their sons or their brothers or their kindred. God, the Most High, informed His Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, with this verse: Have you not seen those who take as allies a people with whom God has become angry? (Al-Mujadilah: 14) They are not from the people of faith nor from the people of the Last Day, and for that reason they took as allies those of the Jews who took as allies. And the people of interpretation said something similar to what we said about that. Who said that? Bishr told us, he said: Yazid told us, he said: Saeed told us, on the authority of Qatada, regarding his statement, You will not find a people who believe in God and the Last Day who have affection for those who oppose God and His Messenger. You will not find, O Muhammad, a people who believe in God and the Last Day who have affection for those who oppose God and His Messenger: that is, those who are hostile to God and His Messenger. And His statement: Those in whose hearts He has decreed faith, God Almighty says: These are the ones who do not love those who oppose God and His Messenger, even if they were their fathers, sons, brothers, or relatives. God has decreed faith in their hearts. What He meant by that is: He has decreed faith for their hearts. So fi has the same meaning as lam. And God Almighty has informed us that He has decreed faith in their hearts for them. This is because faith is in the hearts, and it is known from the report about the hearts that what is meant by it are their people. He has sufficed by mentioning them instead of mentioning their people. And His statement, And He supported them with a spirit from Him, meaning: He strengthened them with proof from Him, light, and guidance. And He will admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow, meaning: He will admit them to orchards beneath whose trees rivers flow. Therein to abide eternally, meaning: They will remain therein forever. God is pleased with them, because of their obedience to Him in this world. And they will be pleased with Him, in the Hereafter, because He admits them to Paradise. Those are the party of God, meaning: Those whose description is like this are the soldiers of God and His allies. Behold, the party of God, meaning: Behold, the soldiers of God and His allies, they are the successful ones, meaning: They are the ones who remain and succeed by attaining what they sought and sought through their allegiance in this world and their obedience to their Lord.
